mapper.select: select point from tbl_member where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
mapper.update: update tbl_member set point = point + #{amount} where member_seq = #{memberSeq}
update tbl_member set point = point - #{amount} where member_seq = #{memberSeq} and point >= #{amount}
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_point_history (point_history_seq, member_seq, history_type, amount, balance, trade_seq) values (seq_point_history.nextval, #{memberSeq}, #{historyType}, #{amount}, #{balance}, #{tradeSeq})
mapper.select: select h.point_history_seq, h.member_seq, h.history_type, h.amount, h.balance, h.trade_seq, to_char(h.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, nvl((select max(tal.title) from tbl_talent tal where tal.expert_seq = t.expert_seq and tal.category_seq = r.category_seq and tal.enabled = 'Y'), cat.name) as service_name from tbl_point_history h left join tbl_trade t on t.trade_seq = h.trade_seq left join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = t.request_seq left join tbl_category cat on cat.category_seq = r.category_seq where h.member_seq = #{memberSeq} order by h.point_history_seq desc
